rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: "An agent builds what the specification says ... Specifying well is the harder half" carries the slide's claim alone; L6 adds the trio division. Closest: L6's first sentence, still a full claim.

L1 "Specifying what to build is now the harder half" is restated literally at L4 "Specifying well is the harder half" and L6 divides who writes it; the header is true of the chunk. Closest: "now" (a time claim) is supported by L4's "builds ... quickly".

L4 "which customer, which step of their journey, what they should be able to do at the end, and which signal" is a four-item enumeration after a verbed sentence naming the set, each item concrete; L4 "a clickable flow, a landing page ..., a short survey" three concrete artefacts, no empty leg. No not-X-not-Y, no superlative, no number+retraction (grep 'most|best|very' in body: none).
